The human performance baseline reaches 68.24, which is significantly higher than the scores of all current mainstream MLLMs, outperforming the best-performing model by 18.92 points. This indicates that there remains substantial room for improvement in the CCS domain.
guideline: The human baseline is derived from responses to the entire set of benchmark tasks, completed by two graduate students majoring in electronic information, each scoring 120 or above in the Chinese language section of the national college entrance examination (Gaokao). With solid literary competence and multimodal comprehension abilities, they represent a general population with basic humanities literacy.
